greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNdodana, nelikaMoya Oyingcwele. Makube kuxolo lwethu ukuba sibe kunye namhlanje phambi koThixo uSomandla.
penitential:
Nkosi, wena ungumalusi olungileyo omfunayo omthandi wakhe. Nkosi, yiba nenceba.
Kristu, wena uyabaxhasa kwaye uyabaphilisa abagulayo nabakhathazekileyo. Kristu, yiba nenceba.
Nkosi, wena ulungiselela itafile yothando phambi kwethu. Nkosi, yiba nenceba.
psalm_response: Nkosi unguMalusi wam; akukho nento eza kungonakala.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho uhamba emzileni othile oqhelekileyo, ubona indoda ehamba phambi kwemihlambi yezimvu, iphethe intonga encinci yokukhokela, ibiza igama ngalinye lezimvu zayo ngezwi eliphantsi nelizolileyo. Ziyayazi loo lizwi. Ziyayilandela kuba zazi ukuba akukho bungozi buzakuzifica. Namhlanje, kwiCawa yoNyaka kaKristu uKumkani wendalo yonke, siziva lo myalezo umnandi: uThixo akayeki ukuba ngumalusi wethu. KwiNcwadi ka Ezekiel namhlanje, uThixo uthi: 'Mna uqobo ndiya kuzikhathalela izimvu zam, ndizindibandisele.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Ndiyakuzikhathalela. Ngaba wakha waziva ngolo hlobo? Xa ubona ihlabathi lizaliswe ziingxaki, xa ubomi buvakala bunzima, uThixo usondela kuwe ngathi ngumalusi osondela kwegusha eyaphukileyo okanye ediniweyo. Akakulahli. Ukuza kwakhe akuza ngamandla okoyikisa, kodwa kuza ngobunono bofefe.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje kaMateyu, uYesu usichazela ngomfanekiso ofanayo. Usitshela ngale mini apho uKumkani wendalo yonke azakuthi ahlukanise izimvu neebhokwe. Kodwa phawula ukuba uKumkani ubabiza ngantoni abo basekunene kwakhe: 'Yizani nina abasikelelweyo nguBawo, nidle ilifa lobukumkani obalungiselelwe nina kwasekusekelweni kwehlabathi.' Kutheni ebabiza? Ngenxa yokuba xa Wayelambile, bamnika ukutya; xa Wayenxano, bamnika ukunela; xa Wayeligqwirha okanye esesibhedlele, bamtyelela. Kwaye xa abantu bemangaliswa besithi, 'Nkosi, sakubona nini ulambile okanye unesifo?' uKumkani uphendula ngelizwi elenza intliziyo ithambe: 'Inene ndithi kuni, enakuwenza kwenye yalaba bafowethu abancinane, nakwenza kum.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Nakwenza kum. Apha kulele imfihlelo enkulu yobomi bethu. Ukukhonza abanye akusiyonto yodwa esiyenzayo ngesandla; kukuhlangana noYesu ngokwakhe kwiindawo eziphantsi nezibuthakathaka zobomi.

Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyanyana emihlanu idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, indlela yenu yaba ngumthwalo onzima. Xa ucinga ngoBenjamin Vo, ngomntwana wenu owayenobukrelekrele obumangalisayo, owakwazi ukucinga nge-'con chim airlines' yakhe encinci nangokuhleka kwakhe okumnandi xa wayesenza imidlalo kwikhompyutha yakhe kwi-github repo yakhe, intliziyo yenu iyavuzwa kukuba ngamanye amaxesha ukungabikho kwakhe kwenza ikhaya libe ngenye indlela. Mamele kakuhle namhlanje: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.' 

Khumbula indlela uBen awayenentliziyo evulekileyo ngayo. Khumbula loo mzuzu omangalisayo xa, eseneminyaka elishumi elinesihlanu ubudala, wathetha nabazali bakhe etsheho ukuba wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayesandula ukuhlaselwa zizifo ezimbini. Wayengazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, kwaye yayingafuneki ngenxa yokuba umalume wayene-insurance, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Le yimfihlelo yobomi: asikokuba unika malini, kodwa ukuba intliziyo yakho ikulungele na ukunika. UBen wayeyiqonda le nto. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukwabelana, owayethanda ukuhleka xa ethetha nge-'con chim airlines' yakhe, owayethanda ukuba noRyan ecaleni kwakhe. Uthando lwakhe lwalungapheliyo, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhanya nangoku.

KwiNcwadi yesiBini, uPawulos usixelela ukuba 'njengoko kuko uAdam bonke abafa, kunjalo naphandle koKristu bonke abaya kuphiliswa.' Kwaye utshabalalisa utshaba lokugqibela, olungukufa. UBen akasekho kweli hlabathi lethu lincinci, kodwa ukwiBanquet yaseZulwini. Ukhona apho iinqwelo-moya zakhe, i-'con chim airlines' yakhe, zibhabha phambi kobuso bukaThixo ngoxolo olungapheliyo. Ngamanye amaxesha, umntu angacinga ngamaphupha. Njengoko uBawo wakhe wakha waba nephupha ngoJuly 2026 apho babemi kulayini wokuthenga ice cream noBen, kwaye uBen wamhlawulela, okanye loo busuku apho uBen wabonakala ephilile, ezinzile, ehleka. Ezo zinto azisizi ngengozi; zizikhumbuzo ezithandekayo zokuba uthando alufa. UBen uphila kuThixo.

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo nolwazi, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho uKumkani wendalo yonke amamkela khona ngocingo oluhlala lukhanya. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
standing_petitions: Ukuze umntwana wethu uBen kunye nabo bonke abasele bedlulile emhlabeni baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu, siyakucela.
Ukuze bonke abasentslungwini nabakhalayo bafumane intuthuzelo nesphefumlo esivela kuThixo uSomandla, siyakucela.

readings.label: Ukufundwa kokuqala
readings.text: Utsho uThixo uNkosi ukuthi: Nanko mna, ndiyazifuna izimvu zam, ndizikhangele. Njengomalusi ozikhangele izimvu zakhe ngamini xa zisasazekileyo phakathi komhlambi wakhe, ndiya kuzikhangela izimvu zam, ndizihlangule kwiindawo zonke ebezasasazeke kuzo ngamini yamafu nobumnyama. Mna ndiya kuzalusa izimvu zam, mna ndiya kuziphumza, utsho uThixo uNkosi. Ezilahlekileyo ndiya kuzifuna, ezidukileyo ndiya kuzibuyisa, ezaphukileyo ndiya kuzibopha, egulayo ndiya kuyiqinisa... Kwaye nina zimvu zam, utsho uThixo uNkosi, ndiya kugwebana phakathi kwegusha negusha, phakathi kweenkunzi zeegusha neebhokwe.

readings.label: IHubo lokuphendula
readings.text:
R. Nkosi unguMalusi wam; akukho nento eza kungonakala.
UYehova ngumalusi wam; andisweli nto.
Ezidlekweni eziluhlaza undenza ndiphumle.
R. Nkosi unguMalusi wam; akukho nento eza kungonakala.
Ngasesandleni samanzi okuphumla undikhokela;
uyawubuyisa umphefumlo wam.
Undikhokela emendweni wobulungisa
ngenxa yegama lakhe.
R. Nkosi unguMalusi wam; akukho nento eza kungonakala.
Ulungiselela itafile phambi kwam
phambi kwamehlo eentshaba zam;
uyawuthanjisela amafutha intloko yam;
inde yachichima ndebe yam.
R. Nkosi unguMalusi wam; akukho nento eza kungonakala.
Inene, ububele nenceba kuya kundilandela
zonke imihla yobomi bam;
ndiya kuhlala endlini kaYehova
ukuba kude kube nini na.

readings.label: Ukufundwa kwesibini
readings.text: Bazalwana: UKristu uvusiwe kwabafileyo, waba ngowokuqala kwabo beleleyo. Ngokuba njengoko ukufa kwavela ngomntu, ukuvuka kwabafileyo kwavela ngomntu kwanjalo. Ngokuba njengoko abafileyo bonke bafile ku-Adam, bawo, nakuKristu bonke baya kuphiliswa. Ke elowo ngendlela yakhe: uKristu owokuqala; emva koko abo bangabakaKristu ekufikeni kwakhe; kwandule ukuza isiphelo, xa aya kunikela ubukumkani kuThixo uBawo, emva kokuba eyibhubhise yonke inkosi, nawo onke amagunya nawo amandla. Ngokuba umelwe kukuba abe ngukumkani kude abe ezibekile zonke iintshaba zakhe phantsi kweenyawo zakhe. Utshaba lokugqibela oluya kubhubhiswa kukufa. Xa ke zonke izinto ziya kuba zithobekile kuye, uMntwana ngokwakhe uya kuzithoba kuye owazithobayo zonke izinto phantsi kwakhe, ukuze uThixo abe yinto zonke kubo bonke.

readings.label: Ivangeli
readings.text: UYesu wathi kubafundi bakhe: Xa uNyanga woMntu aya kufika ebukhanyeni bakhe, eneedinga zonke kunye naye, uya kuhlala esihlalweni sakhe sobukumkani bobuqaqambileyo; ziya kuhlanganiswa phambi kwakhe zonke iintlanga, azahlule omnye komnye, njengomalusi ozahlulayo izimvu neebhokwe. Ziya kubekwa izimvu ngasekunene kwakhe, ibhokwe ngasekunene kwakhe. Wothi ke uKumkani kwabasekunene kwakhe: Yizani nina abasikelelweyo nguBawo, nidle ilifa lobukumkani obalungiselelwe nina kwasekusekelweni kwehlabathi. Ngokuba ndalamba wandipha ukutya, ndanxana wandipha ukunela, ndaba ngumhambi wandamkela, ndaba ze wandambesa, ndaba ngumntu osempilweni nakwabo ndandiphathwa, ndaba semotweni wandiyelela... Inene ndithi kuni, enakuwenza kwenye yalaba bafowethu abancinane, nakwenza kum.

spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kwiSakramente Eyingcwele yaseAltar. Ndikuthanda ngaphezu kwazo zonke izinto, kwaye ndinqwenela ukuba nawe emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze kuMoya wam ngendlela yomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokuba sele ufikile, ndizibandakanya kuwe ngokuphelele; musa ukundivumela ukuba ndahlukane nawe nanini na. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uThixo uSomandla angakusikelela kwaye akugcine kuxolo lwakhe lonke. Amen.
day: The Solemnity of Our Lord Jesus Christ, King of the Universe

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
